limitations: IELTS membership is an independent ECDICT word-list tag, not official exam frequency.
BNC and contemporary corpus ranks measure general English; the latter corpus identity is not independently verified.
Three contexts per card were individually checked against the selected sense. Community examples are not IELTS exam excerpts.
Official IELTS public-sample observed counts are reported separately in vocabulary-frequency.json.

structuralAndOriginTests.coverage: All 2,000 cards for vocabulary size, uniqueness and retained rank evidence; all 1,700 additions for bilingual gloss, POS, IPA, origin labels and context links; all 5,100 added contexts for target spans, lengths, source records or original genres; a deterministic 41-card sample for distinct English quiz choices.

rawSourceReconciliation.result: All redistributed community texts, authors and bilingual pairs reconcile with hash-locked raw exports.

focusedSemanticReview.checks: POS, English/Chinese sense agreement, and every one of the three selected or replacement contexts were read individually. Both review outputs were also checked for source-ID existence, complete coverage, exact target counts, unique contexts, original translations and verbatim collocations.

resolvedFindings.issue: First-source WordNet senses sometimes selected a rare or unrelated meaning, including proper names.
resolvedFindings.remediation: Individually reviewed selection, explicit exclusions, common-sense editorial definitions, POS and heteronym corrections; adaptations carry the edited origin label.

resolvedFindings.issue: Automated POS and author filters admitted wrong-POS, archaic, offensive, duplicated, or misleading examples.
resolvedFindings.remediation: Individually inspected source alternatives or three newly authored contexts. Original material has no community attribution and uses the editorial origin label.

resolvedFindings.issue: Dictionary membership and general-language rank could be mistaken for recent IELTS exam frequency.
resolvedFindings.remediation: UI and retained metadata distinguish ECDICT IELTS-list membership, BNC/source contemporary ranks, and separately observed official public-sample counts.

materialLimits: IELTS tags are independent dictionary selection evidence, not IELTS endorsement, a recent exam count, or an exam probability.
The identity and measurement date of the dictionary contemporary-corpus field are not independently established; it is not relabelled as COCA.
Source phonetics are primarily British according to ECDICT, with legacy notation normalised; every imported UK/US pronunciation variant has not been independently certified.

Community author/native-language claims and source licensing metadata do not themselves certify linguistic quality. Individual review reduced identified defects; it is not a guarantee against every possible stylistic or sense issue.
Only genuine aligned community translations are displayed. Missing source translations remain empty; the separately labelled original contexts have authored Chinese translations.

rawLexicalSourceReconciliation.parser: PowerShell native Import-Csv with UTF-8; does not import or call the dictionary builder
rawLexicalSourceReconciliation.result: All 2,000 final-word IELTS tags and both general rank fields match the independently parsed raw CSV; the verified evidence vector also matches the final frozen pack.

independentAudit.namedCorpusFinding: The named BNC rank alone places 1,903 of 2,000 words (95.15%) within its first 10,000 ranks; this finding does not depend on the unidentified contemporary-corpus field.
